output.reason: The release note on its own [ev-0ea9d499ebef] is vague, but the linked PR states the change concretely. The subject is the `on-deployed` trigger in the notifications catalog [ev-f287b333d1a4]. The files changed are notifications_catalog/triggers/on-deployed.yaml and notifications_catalog/install.yaml [ev-4f1a8b44a18b]. The change is a new condition that compares `app.status.operationState.finishedAt` with `app.status.health.lastTransitionTime`, so the trigger fires only when the health time is not older than the operation time [ev-f287b333d1a4, ev-193b85097c12]. Exposed environments are those using the catalog `on-deployed` trigger. If the operator does nothing, the trigger stops sending the false-positive notifications it used to send while a sync was still in progress, which is a behaviour change with no breakage stated.
